questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be prepared to allow merging traffic to safely enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path before proceeding. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from another road. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging traffic space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black letters means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction ahead. Slow down and be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions for traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are near or entering a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand and arm signals since bicycles don't have turn signals. A left arm held straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, or utility work areas. They help people drive and walk safely through these zones. Traffic fines may double in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You will see this sign on vehicles that move slowly on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed here. You must obey this traffic law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane will need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the number of lanes is decreasing ahead. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs with a fluorescent yellow-green background alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign prohibits right turns where it is posted. You must obey this traffic law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge from the right.
